source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor

items.name: Light Vulnerability
items.text: Attacks against the Leaf of Talhindir are treated as magical if made by a creature who is in magical light or with an object that is in magical light (such as from the Light spell).

items.name: Slink in Shadows
items.text: The Leaf of Talhindir can hide or end its sneak in a creature's or object's shadow.

items.name: Weight of Darkness
items.text:
Requirements The Leaf of Talhindir made a successful Strike against a living creature with its withered touch on its previous action

---
Effect The Leaf of Talhindir chains the soul of the creature. They must attempt a DC 15 Will save save. On a failure, the creature is Enfeebled 1. This is cumulative with other enfeebled conditions from other Leaves of Talhindir or shadows, to a maximum of Enfeebled 4. The enfeebled value from Weight of Darkness decreases by 1 every minute.
